t: 英国军队在栅栏登陆，然后攻击李堡。大陆军开始在新泽西州撤退。
te: British forces land at the Palisades and then attack Fort Lee. The Continental Army starts to retreat across New Jersey.
dz: 美国独立战争：英国军队在栅栏登陆，然后攻击李堡。大陆军开始在新泽西州撤退。
de: American Revolutionary War: British forces land at the Palisades and then attack Fort Lee. The Continental Army starts to retreat across New Jersey.

t: 在詹金斯耳之战期间,英国和西班牙军队之间的波多贝略战役开始了.
te: Start of the Battle of Porto Bello between British and Spanish forces during the War of Jenkins' Ear.
dz: 在詹金斯耳之战期间,英国和西班牙军队之间的波多贝略战役开始了.
de: Start of the Battle of Porto Bello between British and Spanish forces during the War of Jenkins' Ear.

t: 宗比是巴西早期前逃亡奴隶多斯·帕尔马雷斯(Quilombo dos Palmares)的最后一…
te: Zumbi, the last of the leaders of Quilombo dos Palmares in early Brazil, is executed by the forces of Portuguese bandei…
dz: 宗比是巴西早期前逃亡奴隶多斯·帕尔马雷斯(Quilombo dos Palmares)的最后一位领导人,被葡萄牙班德罗·多明戈斯·豪尔赫·维尔霍(Domingos Jorge Velho)的部队处决.
de: Zumbi, the last of the leaders of Quilombo dos Palmares in early Brazil, is executed by the forces of Portuguese bandeirante Domingos Jorge Velho.

t: 克雷莫纳和平会结束了威尼斯共和国和米兰公国之间的战争,此前威尼斯在每鹿加列亚人的军事工程事业上…
te: The Peace of Cremona ends the war between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan, after the victorious Venetian …
dz: 克雷莫纳和平会结束了威尼斯共和国和米兰公国之间的战争,此前威尼斯在每鹿加列亚人的军事工程事业上取得了胜利.
de: The Peace of Cremona ends the war between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan, after the victorious Venetian enterprise of military engineering of the Galeas per montes.

t: 无所畏惧的约翰·勃艮第公爵和奥尔良公爵瓦卢瓦的路易同意停战,但三天后勃艮第将杀死奥尔良.
te: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, and Louis of Valois, Duke of Orléans, agree to a truce, but Burgundy would kill Or…
dz: 无所畏惧的约翰·勃艮第公爵和奥尔良公爵瓦卢瓦的路易同意停战,但三天后勃艮第将杀死奥尔良.
de: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, and Louis of Valois, Duke of Orléans, agree to a truce, but Burgundy would kill Orléans three days later.

t: 巴勒莫被神圣罗马皇帝亨利六世所征服.
te: Palermo is conquered by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 巴勒莫被神圣罗马皇帝亨利六世所征服.
de: Palermo is conquered by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 安史之乱期间，唐朝在回纥部落的帮助下，从叛军手中收复洛阳。
te: During the An Shi Rebellion, the Tang dynasty, with the help of Huihe tribe, recaptures Luoyang from the rebels.
dz: 安史之乱期间，唐朝在回纥部落的帮助下，从叛军手中收复洛阳。
de: During the An Shi Rebellion, the Tang dynasty, with the help of Huihe tribe, recaptures Luoyang from the rebels.

t: 戴克里先被选为罗马皇帝。
te: Diocletian is chosen as Roman emperor.
dz: 戴克里先被选为罗马皇帝。
de: Diocletian is chosen as Roman emperor.
